notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 a-b-c
notes.notes:
**Patch a**

- Balanced the English audio mix for cleaner sound.

**Patch b**

- Language selector in the Options menu now shows the correct language.

- Controller selector appears the first time you open the menu (no more double-pause trick).

**Patch c**

- Collectible documents no longer conflict after opening the inventory, pause menu or To-Do list.

- AI nerfed: reduced vision range, speed and FOV for easier gameplay.

- Added 4 missing Kevin reactions; they now trigger properly.

- Major respawn bug fixed: invisible wall removed.

notes.title: Steamfest - Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
We are excited to present version 1.2.0 for the Steamfest!
This update includes many improvements and new content:

AI: enhanced vision, logic and enemy behavior, making them more dangerous and reactive.

Hiding: ability to hide to avoid enemies.

Audio: improved sound design and atmosphere.

Graphics: various visual enhancements.

Props: new environmental elements for better world consistency.

Story: additional story content.

Thank you for your support and enjoy the Steamfest!

notes.title: #1 - Update - The To do list version 1.1.13
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.13 - Demo

What’s new in this version:

 Expanded exterior : the house opens up even more! New windows now show the outside, with an additional neighborhood now visible.
 Car event : a new interaction related to the car outside.
 Cutscene polish : multiple improvements to the killer’s intro cutscene for smoother and more intense pacing.
 Main menu rework : new lighting effects, improved layout, and clearer information.
